text:

subject: the harder problem after quality
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the cinematic outputs from Seedance 2.0!

Generation quality is table stakes now. The harder problem we've seen is that aesthetics and contextual cues that resonate with one user segment can be completely different from another (ads creator vs. filmmaker; American vs. Chinese markets, etc.)

We help video generation teams like Synthesia, Flawless and Tavus navigate this - improving diversity of human feedback and automating annotation, evaluation and QA review workflows. The objective is richer fine-tuning data: time-aligned audio-visual datasets for SFT and multi-dimensional preference signals for RLHF.

How are you thinking about output alignment at [COMPANY]? Worth a quick chat?

subject: Content moderation at scale
text:
Hi [NAME],

We just onboarded a brand safety team, helping them scale
auto-classification across markets. The main challenge was to understand
which model configuration performs best at automating manual moderation at
scale, while accounting for regional policy variation and
contextually-dependent content cues.

Here's how we're approaching it at Encord: we've built out a platform to
orchestrate model configuration (prompt + LLM/VLM/OCR pairing), model
performance evaluation and human labelling and verification in one place.

Would you be open to exchange perspectives on how you're navigating this?
